description: Ideas for what to try next, based on this store's own setup and numbers. Without `app`: across all installed EA Apps.

app.description: Which EA app: sticky_cart = EA Sticky Add to Cart Drawer (cart drawer, sticky add-to-cart bar, quick buy, cart upsells, rewards / free-shipping goals, every editor setting incl. custom CSS / HTML and templates, cart A/B tests, cart translations, checkout payment / shipping method rules); bundles = EA Bundles & Quantity Breaks (bundle deals, quantity breaks, upsell popups, checkout upsells); popups = EA Email Popup & Spin Wheel (spin-to-win wheel and email / SMS sign-up popup campaigns); translate = EA AI Language Translate (store translation and language selector); accessibility = EA Accessibility ADA WCAG EAA (accessibility widget and store accessibility scans); page_speed = EA SEO & Page Speed Optimizer (speed optimisations and SEO); free_shipping_bar = EA Free Shipping Bar & Upsell (free shipping progress bar); rewards_bar = EA Rewards Bar & Free Gifts (gift and rewards progress bar); announcement_bar = EA Announcement Bar Banner (announcement bar); countdown_bar = EA Countdown Timer Bar (countdown timer bar)

store.description: Which connected store (its myshopify address, e.g. other-store.myshopify.com). Leave it out for the default store; list_stores shows them.
